user.title: 1 · Choose countries
user.description: Create a search profile. Toll prices and route checks require a personal API key. [Register for a free API key]({api_signup_url}). Car searches work without it, but toll and route checks remain unavailable. The key is sent from Home Assistant to BompengeAppen, never in phone notifications.

data_description.toll_api_key: Need a key? [Register for a free API key]({api_signup_url}). The key is only used for toll and route requests.

route.title: 2 · From, to and travel dates
route.description: Select pickup, return, radius and optional dates. All dates removes date restrictions. For mobile alerts, enable notifications and select a phone. Direction and advanced filters are under Configure.

date.title: 3 · When do you want to travel?
date.description: All dates is the simplest option. Choose a specific day or period if needed; the dates describe Hertz's published offer window, not guaranteed bookable pickup times.

date_window.title: Select travel date(s)
date_window.description: Choose a date or inclusive date range. Your search can be changed later.

registration_date_start.title: Choose first date
registration_date_start.description: Choose the first date. Continue to open the last date.

registration_date_end.title: Choose last date
registration_date_end.description: Optionally select a last date. Leave it blank for one day.

edit_date_start.title: Change first date
edit_date_start.description: Choose the new start date. The end-date step follows automatically.

edit_date_end.title: Change last date
edit_date_end.description: Select an end date, or leave blank for a single day.

error.country_not_ready: Choose Norway or Sweden. The Denmark data source is not ready yet.
error.end_before_start: End date cannot be earlier than start date.
error.notification_device_required: Choose a notification device before enabling alerts.
error.radius_station_unavailable: One or more selected locations have no GPS coordinates. Choose a known Freerider station or set radius to 0 km.
error.radius_center_required: Choose at least one location on the side where radius is greater than 0 km.
error.radius_invalid: Radius must be 0–100 km in increments of 5 km.

init.title: Manage saved Freerider search
init.description: Change only the part you need. Advanced vehicle options and notification settings stay out of the initial setup.

menu_options.costs: Tolls, API key and travel expenses

route.title: Places and dates
route.description: Select pickup, return, radius and optional dates. All dates removes date restrictions. For mobile alerts, enable notifications and select a phone. Direction and advanced filters are under Configure.

dates.title: Travel dates
dates.description: All dates, one day, or an inclusive date range.

date_window.title: Choose dates
date_window.description: The published offer window may differ from bookable pickup times.

filters.title: Vehicle preferences
filters.description: Search for parts of model names, such as 'Crafter; Transporter'. Include or exclude model terms. Unknown gearboxes and vehicle types are not guessed.

updates.title: Checks and notifications
updates.description: Pause or resume this saved search without deleting its setup. A paused search will not fetch provider listings or send car alerts. The notification recipient and filters are preserved.

data.notify_events: Also emit events for HA automations
data.toll_in_notifications: Include estimated tolls in new car alerts (Norway)
data.alert_existing_first_scan: Notify about existing available cars on first scan
data.alert_offer_changes: Also notify when offer dates or availability change

area.title: Stations within a radius
area.description: Choose a radius and one or both GPS-verified stations. Matching stations inside that straight-line distance supplement your other From/To places. Coordinates come only from actual Freerider stations. 0 disables radius search.

costs.title: Tolls, API key and travel expenses
costs.description: Get a free key (500 requests/day) from [BompengeAppen API portal]({api_signup_url}). Enter it for toll quotes, planned routes and any road-obstruction flags included in the route response. Blank preserves an existing key. No direct connection to a separate Statens vegvesen API. Other costs are estimates.

data.toll_api_key: API key (leave blank to keep the existing key)

data_description.toll_api_key: [Get a free key]({api_signup_url}). Leave blank to keep an existing saved key.

alerts.title: Alert preferences
alerts.description: Optional Norwegian-local quiet hours (HH:MM). Optionally allow offers expiring soon through. A maximum toll limit is applied only when a quote exists; unknown costs do not pass the limit. Zero means no limit.

data.quiet_urgent_bypass: Allow urgent offers during quiet hours (expires within 3 hours)
data.alerts_only_feasible: Only alert when travel time margin is known and positive
